component.name: Videos
component.summary: Watch the videos on your PC

description.p: Videos plays the films and clips on your PC. Chapters show on the seek bar, subtitles come from the file or a .srt file beside it, and you can pick the audio track, change the speed, watch full screen or keep the video in a small window on top of your other windows.

The other videos in the same folder are listed beside the picture, and Videos remembers where you stopped in each one, so it picks up there next time. The media keys and the media controls in the taskbar work with it. Positions and thumbnails stay on this PC: nothing is streamed or looked up online.
